Those who didn't see the 2008 financial crisis coming and don't understand what caused it are just as clueless about the greater financial crisis that's about to hit.

There was a financial crisis in 2008 because rising interest rates caused loans to default and collateral to lose value. This resulted in large losses for lenders. This time, even more loans will default, and loan collateral and other bank-owned assets will lose even more value, resulting in an even bigger financial crisis.

The only way the Fed can postpone a financial crisis is to trade it for much higher inflation. My money is on the latter. This choice will eventually lead to a U.S. dollar and sovereign debt crisis, but the Fed would rather deal with that crisis in the future than a less catastrophic financial crisis in the present.
